subject: Request: Additional POC runway + one-time commercial concession
messages:
From: Priyanka Sethi <priyanka@orionhealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot status and ask: extension + POC credit request

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the POC is looking promising and the team here is excited about the latency/cost profile. We hit a snag on procurement: their internal timeline has slipped and they want a formal amendment so the trial window doesn't expire before we can get a PO in.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood extend the POC end date by 30 days?
- Can you make a one-time uplift of free credits beyond the PLG cap so we can finish the last two integration cycles (estimated ~50k tokens)?

I attached the draft SOW and an internal timeline from procurement. We can provide a PO as soon as procurement finalizes, but that may be 3–4 weeks out.

Appreciate any flexibility — this is a strategic initiative for our observability platform and they want to see the final end-to-end tests against real traffic.

Best,
Priyanka Sethi
Senior PM, Platform Integrations
Orion Health

Subject: Internal: Orion ask — one-time credits + 30d extension (context and recommendation)

Jordan — forwarding Priyanka's ask. TL;DR: Procurement slipped, prospect requests 30d extension and ~50k tokens of additional free credit beyond standard PLG cap to finish integration tests. HubSpot deal attached: ORION-12345.

Why approve:
- Orion's platform team has real product-market fit signals and we've seen >2x token usage after onboarding limited users.
- Competitive risk: they have an internal partner evaluating two other options simultaneously; losing runway jeopardizes conversion.
- Likely ARR: $180k ARR if they convert.

My recommended one-time concession:
- Credit uplift: 40k tokens (one-off, non-recurring)
- POC extension: 21 days (instead of full 30d; we can revisit if procurement delay extends further and they provide a signed PO commitment date)
- Offer a 5% one-time invoice credit at conversion if PO is received within 45 days (as a commercial sweetener)

If Deal Desk signs off, Michael will get final notice to communicate to the buyer. We want to avoid setting a precedent, so mark this as a one-off for Orion (deal_id: ORION-POC-2025-042).

Please confirm approval or next steps.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 26 Jun 2025 11:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Internal: Orion ask — one-time credits + 30d extension (context and recommendation)

Thanks for the context, Laura. I reviewed the HubSpot notes and the conversion math. Given the ARR profile and limited downside, Deal Desk will authorize a constrained exception with clear guardrails. Approval details below.

Approved one-time items (Deal Desk exception):
- Free usage credit: 40,000 token-equivalent (non-recurring, applied to POC account)
- POC extension: 21 calendar days from the current POC end date
- Commercial sweetener: conditional 5% invoice credit on first invoice if PO is received and invoiced within 45 days

Conditions / required actions:
1) Customer signs an addendum to the MSA documenting the extension and non-recurring credit (Legal will prepare).
2) Procurement provides an estimated PO delivery date; finance needs that recorded in NetSuite for revenue planning.
3) This concession is a one-time exception tied to deal_id ORION-POC-2025-042 and cannot be cited as precedent.

I will route the amendment to Legal and RevOps. Michael — if you approve this wording, I'll draft the credit memo and route to Legal/Finance for signatures.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
